 Outlook outages reported in Los Angeles and other parts of U.S. 
 Microsoft says it is investigating the problem after users reported email access issues. 
 By Jonathan Lloyd • 
 Published 34 minutes ago • 
 Updated 9 minutes ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Microsoft Outlook users reported outages Thursday morning in Los Angeles and other parts of the United States.
 The company said it is investigating the access issue.
 Stream Los Angeles News for free, 24/7, wherever you are.
   WATCH HERE 
 "We're investigating reports of users experiencing issues accessing Exchange Online mailboxes through multiple connection methods in the Americas," the company said in a post on X . While we're working to mitigate impact, we've confirmed the issue may affect Microsoft 365 service connectivity for users in any region."
 Exchange Online is a message platform from Microsoft that supports business email, calendars and other services used by organizations around the world .
 More details about what caused the problem and when it will be resolved were not immediately available.
 Users in Los Angeles, Denver, Dallas, Atlanta, Chicago and major cities in the northeast reported problems, according to Downdetector . The tracking website showed a spike in outage reports just after 9 a.m.
 Earlier Thursday, Microsoft reported issues for users accessing the company's Teams tool, but said service was being restored.
